titles.ja: うちの会社の小さい先輩の話

title.ja: うちの会社の先輩は小さくて可愛い
title.en: My Senpai Is Small and Cute
title.fr: Ma supérieure au boulot est petite et adorable
title.x-jat: Uchi no Kaisha no Senpai wa Chiisakute Kawaii

1.overview: Shinozaki Takuma is in his first year of employment at his new job, and is encountering a lot of the same struggles most new workers run into. But the presence of a cute, doting senpai named Katase Shiori might make the job worth it, no matter how tough it gets.
1.summary:
Shinozaki Takuma is in his first year of employment at his new job, and is encountering a lot of the same struggles most new workers run into. But the presence of a cute, doting senpai named Katase Shiori might make the job worth it, no matter how tough it gets.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: こう見えて意外とお姉さんでしょ?
title.en: Despite Appearances, I`m More the Big Sister Type.
title.fr: On ne dirait pas, mais je ferais une bonne épouse, non ?
title.x-jat: Kou Miete Igai to Onee-san Desho?

2.overview: After their manager's attempt to arrange a romantic dinner for the two of them, a rainy day leaves Shinozaki feeling under the weather, and Shiori decides to check in on him.
2.summary:
After their manager`s attempt to arrange a romantic dinner for the two of them, a rainy day leaves Shinozaki feeling under the weather, and Shiori decides to check in on him.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 私って, こんな風に見えてるんですか?
title.en: Is This How I Look to You?
title.fr: C’est comme ça que vous me voyez ?

3.overview: Shinozaki and Shiori reminisce over past experiences at work during lunch with Akina. On their way back to the office they happen upon a crane game with plushies that remind them of one another.
3.summary:
Shinozaki and Shiori reminisce over past experiences at work during lunch with Akina. On their way back to the office they happen upon a crane game with plushies that remind them of one another.

title.ja: 篠崎さんの事は, まだ...
title.en: When It Comes to Him, I`m Not Sure Yet...
title.fr: À propos de Shinozaki, je ne sais pas trop…

4.overview: Chinatsu has plans to attend a cosplay event on a day off from work and doesn't want her coworkers to know. While on her way she happens to bump into her manager. Later on, Katase has a piece of chocolate for Halloween that contains alcohol.
4.summary:

title.ja: 寄り道して帰りませんか?
title.en: Shall We Go Somewhere Before Heading Home?
title.fr: Ça vous dirait, de faire un petit détour avant de rentrer ?

5.overview: On their way back to the office from a client meeting, Shinozaki and Shiori are approached by a reporter looking to do a story on a couple and, after some discussion, the pair decide to pretend to be a couple for her video.
5.summary:
On their way back to the office from a client meeting, Shinozaki and Shiori are approached by a reporter looking to do a story on a couple and, after some discussion, the pair decide to pretend to be a couple for her video.

title.fr: Je ne peux pas résister à mes instincts !

6.overview: It's the end of the year, and as Shinozaki and Shiori are filled with anticipation for a new year, Chinatsu is staring down a deadline for her new dojinshi, with her only help coming from an unexpected individual.
6.summary:
It`s the end of the year, and as Shinozaki and Shiori are filled with anticipation for a new year, Chinatsu is staring down a deadline for her new dojinshi, with her only help coming from an unexpected individual.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 本当にいらないんですか?
title.en: You Sure You Don`t Want One?
title.fr: Vous êtes sûr de ne pas en vouloir ?

7.overview: Returning to work after New Year's Shiori thinks she's gotten taller and she asks Shinozaki if he notices anything different about her. Later, Yutaka swipes her brother's phone and sends a message to Shiori asking for a picture.
7.summary:

title.ja: 良い子は寝る時間ですよ?
title.en: Isn`t It Time for Good Boys to Go to Sleep?
title.fr: Pour les gentils garçons, c’est l’heure d’aller dormir, non ?
title.x-jat: Yoi Ko wa Neru Jikan Desu yo?

8.overview: The office gang decide to use some of their paid time off to go on a hot springs vacation. At the inn's pool Shinozaki finds out that Shiori can't swim so he wants to help teach her.
8.summary:
The office gang decide to use some of their paid time off to go on a hot springs vacation. At the inn`s pool Shinozaki finds out that Shiori can`t swim so he wants to help teach her.

9.overview: Shinozaki and Shiori are asked to get some old Meowtaro merchandise from the basement storage. While looking through things a couple co-workers wander in looking for some alone time and Shinozaki and Shiori quickly hide.

title.ja: ごっことはいえ, 後輩さんと...
title.en: Even If We`re Just Playing, He`s My Kohai...
title.fr: Même si ce n’est qu’un jeu, faire ça avec mon subordonné…
title.x-jat: Gokko to wa Ie, Kouhai-san to...

10.overview: It's Sunpick's 40th anniversary and the new hire competition is about to kick off. The prize is a vacation to Okinawa for the winner's department. Shinozaki is aiming to win, but Dev Group 1's chief, Akina's old rival, has other plans.

title.ja: ぎゅっとしてみていいですか?
title.en: Can I Give You a Big Hug?
title.fr: Je peux vous faire un câlin ?

11.overview: With the new hire competition in full swing, Shinozaki is worried about the pressure Kurusu is dealing with and asks Shiori to help cheer her up. The groups then give their presentations. Who will win the Most Valuable New Hire Award?

12.overview: Yamagishi has finished working on her Meowtaro game and wants Shinozaki to play it. Things become stressful for Shinozaki and Shiori when some of the game's dialog hits too close to home. Later on everyone tries to make plans together for Golden Week.
